name: RSNA 3D Medical Multiview Classification Pipeline Template
summary: Reusable base CDG for RSNA-style 3D medical imaging classification, knee injury MRI, hip fracture X-ray identification, lumbar/cervical spine grading, multiview injury detection, fracture detection, and cancer-risk classification competitions that combine anatomy or ROI localization, 2.5D/3D backbones such as 3D ConvNeXt, MaxViT, ConvNeXt-v2, or Swin Transformer encoders, sagittal/coronal/axial cross-view attention, coordinate-regression auxiliary losses, 3D elastic augmentation, weighted multiclass or asymmetric losses, patient-level GroupKFold, and metric-specific calibration.
dejargonized_summary: Find or crop the relevant part of a 3D scan or medical image, build views from sagittal, coronal, and axial slices or full volumes, train a 3D or multiview model with patient-safe validation, use auxiliary coordinate or ROI losses when localization matters, and calibrate class probabilities for the medical benchmark metric.

inputs.name: medical_images
inputs.constraints: 3D volumes, 2.5D slices, multiview studies, labels, patient IDs, or ROI annotations.

outputs.name: medical_predictions
outputs.constraints: Class probabilities, diagnosis labels, injury labels, or risk scores formatted for the benchmark metric.

use_when: The task predicts medical classes, injuries, fractures, grades, or cancer-risk labels from 3D volumes, multiview MRI/CT studies, pelvic X-rays, or ROI-centered medical images.

Winning techniques include 3D ConvNeXt-Tiny, ConvNeXt-v2, MaxViT, Swin Transformer encoders, cross-view attention, YOLOv8-X ROI localization, coarse-to-fine ROI cropping, coordinate-regression auxiliary loss, 3D elastic deformation, MixUp/CutMix on ROI crops, weighted multiclass log loss, asymmetric loss, or patient GroupKFold.
Patient/study grouping and view fusion are load-bearing, not just ordinary image classification.
do_not_use_when: The task is pure 2D natural image classification with no medical study grouping or anatomy localization.
The output is a pixel-level segmentation mask and the solution is dominated by segmentation tiling rather than classification or risk scoring.
The task is medical tabular prediction where images are only optional metadata.
applicability.key_insight: The durable topology is anatomy-aware localization followed by 3D or multiview feature fusion under patient-safe validation. This differs from generic 3D imaging CDGs because cross-view attention, auxiliary coordinates, and patient grouping are load-bearing.

swappable_stages.study_localization: Can use coarse-to-fine ROI cropping, YOLOv8-X/Faster R-CNN ROI detection, coordinate regression, segmentation pretraining, or anatomy-specific slice selection.
swappable_stages.cross_view_backbone: Can use 3D ConvNeXt, Swin-UNet, 3D ResNet, EfficientNet-3D, ConvNeXt-v2, MaxViT, 2.5D CNNs, or transformer cross-view attention.
swappable_stages.auxiliary_and_weighted_losses: Can use weighted multiclass log loss, asymmetric loss, focal loss, coordinate regression auxiliary loss, or multi-task structure labels.

applicability.scaling_notes: Cache resampled volumes and ROI crops, use mixed precision for 3D backbones, and fit all preprocessing inside patient-safe folds.
failure_modes: Random image-level folds leak patient information and overstate performance.
ROI localization errors can dominate the classifier even when the backbone is strong.
Aggressive 3D augmentation can distort anatomy if spacing and orientation are not normalized first.

planning_constraints.subject: patient_grouping_before_validation
planning_constraints.statement: Define patient or study groups before model selection, augmentation tuning, or calibration.
planning_constraints.rationale: Medical images from the same patient or study can leak across folds if grouping is applied late.

planning_constraints.subject: localization_before_cross_view_fusion
planning_constraints.statement: Localize the anatomy or ROI before assembling multiview or 3D representations for classification.
planning_constraints.rationale: Cross-view attention and 3D backbones assume the informative anatomy is consistently framed.

audit.rationale: Added after validation left repeated divergent RSNA and medical imaging cases with missing techniques around 3D ConvNeXt/Swin-UNet backbones, multiview ROI fusion, transformer cross-view attention, coordinate-regression auxiliary losses, 3D elastic augmentation, weighted multiclass/asymmetric losses, and GroupKFold by patient. Semantic comparison found existing RSNA brain tumor and cervical spine CDGs too competition-specific.
audit.dejargonized_summary: This covers medical classification solutions where 3D anatomy, multiple imaging views, ROI localization, and patient-safe validation are the reusable structure.
uncertainty_notes: Pure segmentation and whole-slide MIL cases should remain on their existing segmentation or MIL CDGs unless classification fusion is central.

references.title: Sciona 135-CDG expansion validation audit
references.note: Local deterministic and semantic audit of unmatched 3D medical multiview patterns.

stages.name: Study Localization
stages.description: Normalize orientation and spacing, then localize anatomy or ROI with coordinate regression, coarse-to-fine cropping, YOLOv8-X/Faster R-CNN ROI detection, segmentation pretraining, or slice selection for knee MRI, pelvic X-ray, hip fracture, or spine studies.
stages.dejargonized_description: Find the relevant anatomy or crop before classification.
preconditions: Image orientation, spacing, and patient IDs are available.
guarantees: Relevant anatomy is framed consistently enough for view fusion.

stages.name: Multiview Volume Assembly
stages.description: Build 3D volumes, 2.5D slice stacks, sagittal/coronal/axial views, planar ROI crops, hip-joint crops, or spatio-temporal feature stacks with fold-local normalization plus 3D elastic deformation, MixUp, CutMix, and ROI-crop TTA when appropriate.
stages.dejargonized_description: Create the model inputs from full volumes, slices, or multiple medical views.
preconditions: ROI and view policy are fixed.
guarantees: Each patient or study has aligned model inputs.

stages.name: Cross-View Backbone
stages.description: Train 3D ConvNeXt-Tiny, 3D ConvNeXt, 3D ResNet, EfficientNet-3D, ConvNeXt-v2, MaxViT, Swin Transformer encoders, 2.5D CNN ensembles, or transformer-based cross-view attention over sagittal/coronal/axial MRI and ROI inputs.
stages.dejargonized_description: Learn medical features from 3D data or multiple views of the same study.
preconditions: Backbone and memory policy are selected.
guarantees: Representations fuse the required views or volumes.

stages.name: Auxiliary and Weighted Losses
stages.description: Train classification heads with weighted multiclass log loss, asymmetric loss, focal loss, coordinate-regression auxiliary loss, structure segmentation auxiliary loss, fracture-type labels, surgical-level tear weights, or multi-task labels.
stages.dejargonized_description: Use losses that handle class imbalance and help the model localize anatomy.

outputs.name: raw_medical_scores
outputs.constraints: Raw class, coordinate, or risk scores.

preconditions: Labels, class weights, and auxiliary targets are available.
guarantees: Scores align with the benchmark target labels.

stages.name: Patient-Level Calibration
stages.description: Use patient or study GroupKFold, fold ensembling, mixed-precision checkpoint selection, TTA over ROI crops, threshold tuning, and metric-specific probability calibration.
stages.dejargonized_description: Validate and calibrate predictions without leaking patient information.
preconditions: Patient groups and metric are known.
guarantees: Outputs are patient-safe and formatted for submission.
